Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1999
ACT II OF 1999
Customs (Amendment) Act 1999
An Act further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I , 31st March,
1999]
The following Act of
Mailis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 30th March.
1999, and are hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Customs (Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 18, Act IV of 1969

ACT II OF 1999

1999]
The following Act of
Mailis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 30th March.
1999, and are hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 18, Act IV of 1969.--In the Customs Act,
1969 (IV of 1969), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 18, in
subsection (2), for the word and comma "may," occurring for the first
time, the words and commas "may," on the recommendation, of the
National Tariff Commission constituted under the National Tariff Commission
Act, 1990 (VI of 1990) (the Commission), "provided the National Tariff
Commission follows the same procedure as prescribed in the said Act" shall
be substituted.

Amendment of section 19 Act IV of 1969

ACT II OF 1999
ACT II OF 1999
Customs (Amendment) Act 1999
An Act further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I , 31st March,
1999]
The following Act of
Mailis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 30th March.
1999, and are hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 19 Act IV of 1969.---In the said Act, in
section 19, in subsection (l) for the full stop at the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall he added, namely:--
"Provided
that the Federal Government shall not exempt any goods imported into Pakistan
from the whole or any part of the customs duties chargeable thereon, except in
the following cases, namely:--
(a) For
rectification of tariff related anomalies on the recommendation of National
Tariff Commission; or
(b) for the
fulfilment of an international obligation of the Government of Pakistan; or
(c) for the
purpose of national security."

and

following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(c) the
repayment in whole or in part of the customs duties paid on the importation of

7. Saving.--All notifications issued, orders made, or exemption
granted under sections 19, 20, 21 or 21-A as it existed immediately before the
commencement of the Customs (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998 (XVI of 1998), shall
continue in force but any such notification, order or exemption may, in with
the provisions of this Act, at any time, be rescinded, modified by the Federal
Government.
